name: xbo_lookup_ViaAuthProxy
description: Resolves the Titan XBO id for a customer billing account through the Apigee auth-proxy. Uses GECX dynamic variable "titan_server" as the backing service domain (resolved through the Apigee gateway domain in variable "apigee_server"). The x-url is dynamically constructed with the billing account number; the XBO id is the top-level "id" of the first returned record.
